overflowLinks._why: Item 6a: "Check here if there is not enough space (Attachment 6a)". The answer used to be held to the 856 characters its box prints - the form deciding how much of a reason to keep a child's information private was worth having. Rule the-packet-uses-mc025-for-more-space: the rest continues on MC-025 and the box ticks itself.

computedFields._why: Item 10 asks for the number of pages attached. A filer cannot count them; the packet knows: every MC-025 sheet continuing DV-160 - more minors than item 2b(2) holds (Attachment 2b(2)), more information than the 5c(2) table holds (Attachment 5c(2)), and answers to 6a, 6b, 8b and 8c longer than their boxes. Counted with the layout that draws them, so a list that takes two sheets counts two.

alwaysShown.why: Item 5 is asked whatever the answer to 'Do you have a lawyer?' - the lawyer's block is merely the last thing item 3 asks.

autofilledFields.why: Item 11: a signature date has one correct answer and the form already knows it.
Item 11: the printed name under the signature is the name of the person making the request, given in item 2a.
Item 12: the same date, for the lawyer's signature block - as DV-100 fills its own.
